description: Defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'SubunitCountPair' which encapsulates a 'Subunit' entity and an associated count, representing a pairing of subunit and count within the OrangeHRM dashboard module.

classes.name: SubunitCountPair
classes.description: A DTO class that encapsulates a Subunit entity and an integer count, providing accessors for both.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Subunit and count fields.

methods.name: getSubunit
methods.description: Returns the Subunit entity contained in this pair.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the count associated with this subunit.
